source_or_custodian: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (UNICEF, WHO, World Bank, UN Population Division); via World Development Indicators (WB_WDI)
status_or_notes: No 2025 value; series coverage ends 2024. SDG indicator 3.2.1.
definition: Under-five mortality rate is the probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five, if subject to age-specific mortality rates of the specified year.
